title: How this wiki is built
text:
Every part is a managed AWS service that costs nothing while nobody uses it.

|!Part |!Service |!What it does |
|Page |S3 + CloudFront |Serves `index.html`, scripts and styles |
|Sign-in |Cognito |Invited users only, no self sign-up |
|API |API Gateway + Lambda |Reads and saves tiddlers, checks the sign-in token |
|Tiddlers |DynamoDB |Current text, full history, drafts and open tiddlers |
|Files |S3 + CloudFront |Private bucket, read with a one-hour signed cookie |
|Demo reset |EventBridge + Lambda |Puts everything back every hour |

A table is lines of cells between `|`; a cell that starts with `!` is a heading.
